entities.summary: Riley Alan Greene is an American professional baseball outfielder for the Detroit Tigers of Major League Baseball (MLB). He was drafted fifth overall by the Tigers in the 2019 MLB draft. He made his MLB debut in 2022 and was an All-Star in 2024 and 2025.
